run_annotation_tool_D: run the annotation_tool_D script to generate an MTurk HTMLQuestion XML for comparison and ranking annotation tasks
render_html_question_for_comparison: render an MTurk HTML question form for annotating comparison or ranking properties of highlighted words in a Minecraft command
generate_css_script_for_word_hiding: generate the CSS_SCRIPT template that hides word slots up to MAX_WORDS when no value is provided
generate_js_script_for_child_display: generate the JS_SCRIPT template that displays the relevant question section based on child and reference object names
assemble_before_after_html_templates: assemble the BEFORE and AFTER HTML template strings that wrap MTurk annotation content with Bootstrap styling and instructions
